prompt: Root package.json's test script is a no-op (`echo 'no root tests; test per-package'`). Wire it to actually delegate to each workspace package's own test script using `pnpm -r --if-present run test`, so running the test script from the repo root gives real pass/fail signal instead of doing nothing.
rationale: Fixes a placeholder root script so `pnpm test` from the repo root actually orchestrates per-package tests.

prompt: Add a GitHub Actions workflow at .github/workflows/publish.yml that runs on push to main, uses a matrix over packages/shared and packages/api, and for each package only proceeds to build/publish steps when that package's package.json version changed versus the previous commit (using a path-scoped `git diff HEAD^ HEAD -- packages/<name>/package.json` check), skipping the rest of the job for a package whose version didn't change.
rationale: Realistic selective-publish CI pattern for monorepos, content-verified plus a real per-package command check.

prompt: packages/api has no test script and no tests. Add a "test" script to packages/api/package.json backed by a new packages/api/test/signup.test.js (node:test, no new dependencies) covering both the valid-email (201) and invalid-email (400) POST /signup cases, using an ephemeral port. Then update the ROOT package.json's test script to `pnpm -r --if-present run test` so it now orchestrates both packages/shared and packages/api together from a single root command.
rationale: End-to-end test wiring across two packages plus root orchestration, the strongest possible proof this actually works.

prompt: Add a GitHub Actions workflow at .github/workflows/ci.yml that runs a matrix build across packages/shared and packages/api (a matrix strategy with `package: [shared, api]`), installing with `pnpm install` and then running `pnpm --filter ./packages/${{ matrix.package }} run test --if-present` for each. Root package.json's build/test scripts are no-ops — do not rely on them.
rationale: Realistic monorepo CI matrix; the referenced per-package command is verified directly since the workflow itself can't run here.

checks.command: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('.github/workflows/ci.yml','utf8'); if(!/matrix/.test(s)) process.exit(1); if(!/package:\s*\[\s*shared\s*,\s*api\s*\]/.test(s)) process.exit(1); if(!s.includes('pnpm install')) process.exit(1); if(!s.includes('matrix.package')) process.exit(1); if(!s.includes('--if-present') && !s.includes('run test')) process.exit(1);"

prompt: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml with a GitHub Actions job that uses strategy.matrix.package: [shared, api], runs pnpm install, then pnpm --filter ./packages/${{ matrix.package }} run test --if-present. The workflow must include the substrings matrix, package: [shared, api], pnpm install, and matrix.package.
rationale: Companion to the matrix case with explicit literal graders matching a correct matrix workflow.
